explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() to walk the fragment token-by-token with next_token(), appending only ordinary #text tokens plus the documented TITLE/TEXTAREA opener text via get_modifiable_text(), which excludes script/style contents. The result is truncated by Unicode code points with mb_strlen()/mb_substr() when available, and the function returns an empty string for non-positive limits.
